recommendations.description: Initiate a CT Commercial Individual PPO acute inpatient audit for PA-required craniotomy and sepsis admissions, beginning with Manchester Memorial Hospital and other main contributing CT hospitals, to confirm prior authorization, reconcile approvals to actual admission criteria and level of care, identify claims paid without matching authorization parameters, and validate reimbursement against contract terms.
evidence: PA-required CT PPO acute admissions added about $18.8M from 284 more admissions.
Average paid per admit increased about $5.4K.
Craniotomy cases added about $1.3M with paid per admit up about $92.7K.
Sepsis cases added about $350K on 16 more admissions.
Manchester Memorial Hospital added about $134K from 8 more admissions.

recommendations.description: Implement a targeted payment-integrity and contract-remediation review for Commercial Individual neuro, spine, and post-surgical outlier episodes, prioritizing CA Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC, multiple-level spinal fusion, and CA long-term care hospital/physical rehab follow-on claims, with provider-level authorization-to-claim reconciliation, acute/sub-acute level-of-care validation, itemized bill review, and escalation of suspected DRG upcoding or single-case/outlier payment terms at SANTA CLARA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER and other named outlier facilities.
evidence: CA acute craniotomy outliers center on SANTA CLARA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER.
PA required equals Y on acute, long-term care, and rehab claims.
Post-acute spillover appears in CA long-term care hospital and physical rehab.
Key drivers include traumatic subdural hematoma, cerebral aneurysm, and spinal fusion.
Admissions are up and paid per admit is up.
peer_benchmarking: Paramount Healthcare bundles with primary procedure and cardiac mapping; no separate 3D printing or extra OR charges.
United Health conditionally bundles specified nervous system procedures; never report with 64727 or 69990.

recommendations.description: Implement a targeted inpatient contract-compliance and authorization policy review across OH, CO, and GA for MetroHealth Main Campus Medical Center, Mercy Health-Saint Elizabeth Boardman Hospital, and Emory Hospital Warner Robins, focused on Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC and Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC, to verify denial enforcement, authorization-to-claim matching, DRG coding integrity, itemized billing, and contract-compliant reimbursement, and pursue provider remediation or site-of-care steering where misalignment is found.
evidence: Spend increase concentrated in few providers and high-acuity DRGs.
MetroHealth added about $1.0M on 30 more admissions.
CO craniotomy added about $1.2M with paid per admit up.
GA spend included Emory concentration and major craniotomy growth.
Sepsis admissions are also called out for reimbursement review.

recommendations.description: Initiate a Baylor University Medical Center-focused TX Commercial Individual HMO/POS pathway audit across Acute Hospital and Physical Rehab for Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC and Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC to review initial and concurrent UM, confirm prior authorization and auth-to-claim match, enforce denials, apply sepsis clinical validation, and evaluate Baylor site-of-care or contract remediation.
evidence: Baylor University Medical Center added 44 HMO acute hospital admissions.
Baylor University Medical Center added 40 POS acute hospital admissions.
SEPSIS UNSPECIFIED ORGANISM added 94 admissions.
HEMIPLG FLW CEREB INFARCT LT N-DOM drove neurologic growth.
Physical Rehab growth accompanied Acute Hospital growth in TX.
Operational cards show pa_required_code Y and auth-to-claim validation.
peer_benchmarking: BCBS_TX case-by-case sepsis review requires infection, organ dysfunction, and consistent treatment documentation.

recommendations.description: Implement a KY acute hospital split review: for HMO PA-required non-ER Norton Hospital spinal fusion admissions, review initial and concurrent review KPIs, audit the CUMG decision tree and nurse-to-MD referral pathway, assess elective site-of-care, and validate authorization-to-claim enforcement; for PPO non-PA acute claims, confirm contractual processing and perform itemized-bill and program-integrity review.
evidence: KY HMO acute hospital spend increase is mainly admission-driven.
KY PPO acute hospital spend increase is unit-cost-led.
PA-required HMO and non-PA PPO are both identified drivers.
Auth-to-claim validation is a flagged business term.
Non-ER Norton Hospital spinal fusion appears in drill context.

recommendations.description: Run a claims-processing audit to reclassify and reprocess Commercial Individual inpatient 'Not Mapped' facility claims in CT, KY, and VA, then validate PA-required authorization-to-claim matching and contractual adjudication for CT PPO and KY HMO claims, with focused provider review for Yale New Haven Hospital and Norton Hospital.
evidence: Facility type is explicitly unmapped, so site-of-care attribution is unreliable.
CT Not Mapped claims added about $4.3M with admissions and paid per admit up.
KY Not Mapped claims added about $773K on 12 more admissions.
Source cards flag auth-to-claim validation and unmapped_or_unknown_value.

recommendations.description: Reconcile AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION between authorization source systems and claims in CA, TX, GA, and WI, then audit denial-enforcement, manual adjudication, and reprocessing logic for Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC, Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC, Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC, and Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC across SANTA CLARA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER, PARKLAND HEALTH AND HOSPITAL SYSTEM, AURORA ST. LUKE'S MEDICAL CENTER, and EMORY HOSPITAL WARNER ROBINS before any authorization-driven claims action.
evidence: Several states show spend movement tied to authorization code distribution.
CA, TX, GA, and WI are explicitly flagged for validation before action.
Source cards are labeled auth-to-claim validation and coding validation.
Affected providers include Santa Clara Valley, Parkland, Aurora St. Luke's, and Emory.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna lists 'Requires Auth'; other listed payors show no documented auth requirement detail.

recommendations.description: Tighten inpatient chemotherapy prior-authorization and site-of-care policy for Commercial Individual admissions under DRG "Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC" and diagnosis "ENCOUNTER FOR ANTINEOPLASTIC CHEMO," starting with WI acute hospital activity at Aurora St. Luke's Medical Center and validating payer-specific bundling and contractual claim processing for WI, OH children's, and CA acute claims.
evidence: Primary metric total paid increased; admissions up and paid per admit up.
WI acute hospital chemotherapy names Aurora St. Luke's Medical Center.
Operational chemotherapy cards show pa_required_code Y in WI, OH, and CA.
CA acute EPO chemotherapy is unit-cost led.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna bundles routine facility services and room-and-board; incidental items are not separately reimbursed.
Elevance internal indicates Wisconsin may allow separate reimbursement for facility claims.
Medica bundles chemotherapy observation monitoring into chemotherapy with no separate reporting.
